title: ApprovalPolicyView
description: `GET`/`PUT /api/v1/agent-harness/admin/approvals` (P2.11e): the caller's org's part of the approvals document, for its admins. Another org's entries are never in it.

refused.description: Stored entries of this org the schema refuses; they fail closed until replaced. `*` in `agents`: the org's agent map itself is not a map. An edition's approval-policy section adds whether its own entry is refused (x-extensible).

default.description: The deployment's default rule, read-only here; null when none or refused.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the org's last save; the next save sends it back as `baseUpdatedAt`.

invalid.description: The stored document's top level is not the schema's; an operator fixes it.

names.description: ADR-UI-03: display names of the agents (`policy.agents` keys) the view holds, from one batched lookup, so the page names nothing per id; an edition's approval-policy section adds the names of what it holds (x-extensible). An id nobody could name now (or a failed lookup) is absent; the page shows it as it shows an unnamed id. Absent from a server older than ADR-UI-03.

OrgApprovalPolicy.description: What an org admin edits: the org's rule and its agents' rules. An edition's approval-policy section adds its own value (x-extensible), saved with them under the same compare-and-set.
